# smolvm



ZSH module for smolvm — the Apache-2.0 microVM engine from smol-machines used
to run coding agents in ephemeral microVMs (pinned v1.3.2). 



## Features

- Pinned install (v1.3.2) with SHA256 checksum verification
- Binary installation to ~/.local/bin
- Idempotent module loading with enable/disable toggle






## Requirements

- curl
- sha256sum (Linux) / shasum (macOS)
- KVM support (for running microVMs)
